title: GPT-5.5 vs GPT-5.6-SOL confirmatory four-way first-write bakeoff (§16 Stage B; frozen; no-publish)
_status: DRAFT sealed-protocol manifest. Fields marked OWNER-DECISION are unresolved; the spec validator enumerates exactly what is missing (validation command below). Freezing happens at `migration-bakeoff seal` — after that, verifySealIntact + the unblind hash gate make every field immutable for the run.
_validationCommand: npx tsx ../../../../docs/v25/reports/S16_OWNER_INPUTS/tools/validate-owner-inputs.mts spec <file> (from the pipeline dir; expected to FAIL while OWNER-DECISION placeholders remain)
_booksNote: OWNER-DECISION: ≥2 books from different categories (plan §16), each with compiled v24 artifacts (briefs + source packets) present in pipeline state — they become the frozen shared inputs. Every chapter is spec-tagged with one of the four strata (no pipeline auto-tagging exists; the tag is the owner's design assertion). All four strata must appear. 4 chapters/book × 2 books shown as the minimum shape; more chapters = more blocks = tighter CIs (see _precisionNote).
_samplingNote: Proposed: screening wave = 2 independent first-write samples per cell per chapter; expansion to 3 only if a SOL cell screens clean (frozen rule; evaluated ONCE on interim metrics; decision persisted). With 8 chapters: screening = 8×2×4 = 64 samples, full = 96. Every sample is ONE attempt (firstWriteOnly) — no retries, ≤1 infra replay, never for content/safeguard outcomes.
_judgePanelNote: OWNER-DECISION (proposal shown): a mixed-family panel of 3 — both model families judge, tempering same-family style preference (§13 reviewer-bias row); EVERY judge must pass Stage-Q qualification on the human-labeled C1 corpus or the review phase refuses it. Panel rotation is deterministic; sampleIndex-1 samples get a prespecified second read for the T8 agreement metrics.
_thresholdsNote: OWNER-FREEZE: the approved C4 file copied to this pipeline-relative path before seal; sealed by hash.
_priceNote: null = prices unavailable ⇒ cost fields are MARKED unavailable, never estimated (tokens are structurally unavailable on this route regardless — see C5).
_precisionNote: Honesty pre-declared: with the 8-chapter minimum shape, a zero-event cell supports only a ~37.5% one-sided upper bound per cell (rule-of-three 300/8) and ~9.4% pooled across 32 SOL-cell chapter-blocks — NOT a 1-2% claim. The declared endpoints therefore require 150 independent chapter-units to support a 2% claim; until the design reaches that N, the report marks rare-defect claims 'unproven at this sample size' (PRECISION_STATEMENT) instead of inventing them. Owner may either accept unproven-rare-rate reporting at the small design or grow books/chapters toward the endpoint N.
_unresolvedOwnerFields: books[].bookId + real chapterNumber per stratum tag (chapterNumbers 1-4 are placeholders)
